'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Ryan Mason LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Mason]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ryan Mason]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
